name: Kobee Studio
description: Create PCB labels, variable text, graphics, connector overlays, QR Codes, and board tools inside KiCad
description_full: Kobee Studio creates editable PCB artwork on silkscreen, copper, and solder-mask layers. It includes native KiCad project-variable templates, parametric labels, installed Google Fonts, PCB symbols, SVG/PNG graphics, component callouts and arrays, common and custom-pitch connector overlays, QR Codes, Code 128 barcodes, reusable libraries, and transactional designator and silkscreen board tools. Kobee Studio evolved from KiBuzzard and provides a modern KiCad 10 IPC workflow for creating consistent PCB graphics.
